printer_cfg:
# printer.cfg for printer_v7: GENERATED by mechloop from the electrical model. Do not edit by hand;
# change the design and regenerate. Directions (dir_pin '!') and the extruder rotation_distance must be
# confirmed on the machine; PID values come from a simulated PID_CALIBRATE and should be re-run on the real heater.
# Input shaper, pressure advance and probe offsets below are PREDICTIONS from the simulation, each resting on
# assumed values named beside it: re-measure on the machine (SHAPER_CALIBRATE, a pressure-advance test print,
# PROBE_CALIBRATE, BED_MESH_CALIBRATE).

[mcu]
serial: /dev/ttyAMA0
restart_method: command

[printer]
kinematics: cartesian
max_velocity: 250
max_accel: 4000
max_z_velocity: 12
max_z_accel: 200

[stepper_x]
step_pin: PB13
dir_pin: !PB12
enable_pin: !PB14
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PC0
position_endstop: 0
position_min: 0
position_max: 180
homing_speed: 50

[tmc2209 stepper_x]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 0
run_current: 0.280
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_y]
step_pin: PB0
dir_pin: PC5
enable_pin: !PB1
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PC1
position_endstop: 0
position_min: 0
position_max: 180
homing_speed: 50

[tmc2209 stepper_y]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 1
run_current: 1.200
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_z]
step_pin: PB10
dir_pin: !PB2
enable_pin: !PB11
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 2
endstop_pin: probe:z_virtual_endstop
position_min: -1.550
position_max: 183.100
homing_speed: 5
second_homing_speed: 1
homing_retract_dist: 3

[tmc2209 stepper_z]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 2
run_current: 0.280
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[extruder]
step_pin: PB3
dir_pin: !PB4
enable_pin: !PD1
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 26.8937
gear_ratio: 11.262:1
full_steps_per_rotation: 400
nozzle_diameter: 0.400
filament_diameter: 1.750
heater_pin: PC8
sensor_type: ATC Semitec 104NT-4-R025H42G
sensor_pin: PA0
control: pid
pid_Kp: 39.807
pid_Ki: 15.611
pid_Kd: 25.377
min_temp: 0
max_temp: 280
max_extrude_only_distance: 100
max_extrude_only_velocity: 60
max_extrude_only_accel: 3000
# pressure advance: best of a sweep on the twin (smallest corner bulge + recess), whose melt-flow lag is 32 ms (direct drive, 0.4 mm nozzle: factory pressure-advance values (fitted_parameters.json: extruder_lag_s), range 0.02 to 0.058 s); not measured on this machine: print a pressure-advance test
pressure_advance: 0.0420
pressure_advance_smooth_time: 0.04

[tmc2209 extruder]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 3
run_current: 0.400
sense_resistor: 0.110

[heater_bed]
heater_pin: PC9
sensor_type: Generic 3950
sensor_pin: PC4
control: pid
pid_Kp: 70.920
pid_Ki: 4.460
pid_Kd: 281.907
min_temp: 0
max_temp: 95

[verify_heater extruder]
max_error: 120
check_gain_time: 20
hysteresis: 5
heating_gain: 2

[verify_heater heater_bed]
max_error: 120
check_gain_time: 60
hysteresis: 5
heating_gain: 2

[fan]
pin: PC6

# fan 'hotend_fan' is wired to the board's +5 V rail: it runs whenever the machine is powered (no firmware section)

# mains relay ahead of the 24 V supply: energised while the firmware runs, dropped on any shutdown
[output_pin ps_on]
pin: PC13
value: 1
shutdown_value: 0

# input shaper: predicted by the twin, not measured: resonance X 72.7 Hz, Y 53.3 Hz (belts + FEA frame stiffness); damping assumed. Run SHAPER_CALIBRATE
[input_shaper]
shaper_type_x: ei
shaper_freq_x: 91.8
damping_ratio_x: 0.065
shaper_type_y: mzv
shaper_freq_y: 53.6
damping_ratio_y: 0.069

# probe: offsets from the CAD; z_offset from the probe's nominal switching distance on aluminium (3.0 mm, recalled class value) - set it on the machine with PROBE_CALIBRATE
[probe]
pin: ^!PC2
x_offset: -36.5
y_offset: 13.01
z_offset: 1.200
speed: 5
lift_speed: 10
samples: 3
samples_result: median
sample_retract_dist: 2
samples_tolerance: 0.04
samples_tolerance_retries: 3

# Z homes with the probe over the middle of the bed
[safe_z_home]
home_xy_position: 126.5, 76.99
speed: 100
z_hop: 5
z_hop_speed: 5

# mesh bounds are probe positions: the bed inset by the probe's edge margin, cut to where the probe can reach
[bed_mesh]
speed: 100
horizontal_move_z: 5
mesh_min: 4, 13.01
mesh_max: 143.5, 176
probe_count: 5, 5
algorithm: lagrange
mesh_pps: 2, 2
fade_start: 1
fade_end: 10
fade_target: 0
split_delta_z: 0.01
zero_reference_position: 90, 90
